global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth with tender chashu pork. Fresh green onions and sesame seeds crown the bowl, served in a white ceramic bowl with blue script, set against a vibrant red background under bright, even lighting.

regions.background: The table is a solid, bright red surface with smooth texture and no visible patterns or markings.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with blue Japanese characters and decorative pattern along its rim.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy beige, thick, and swirling with noodles, topped with green onions and sesame seeds.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: tender, browned slices with visible fat marbling and slightly charred surface texture.
